newsitem.title: LATVIA: BALTICS-INVESTMENT CONFERENCE MAY 8 IN RIGA.
newsitem.headline: BALTICS-INVESTMENT CONFERENCE MAY 8 IN RIGA.

text.p: A fund management conference organised by Reuters, the Riga stock exchange and the Latvian Business School and sponsored by Williams de Broe is to be held in Riga on May 8.

The conference will deal with the international and local experience in the Baltic markets, investment strategies and risk management strategies in the Baltic and the opportunities for corporations and liquidity management.
It is aimed at various financial specialists including portfolio managers, chief financial officers, investment and commercial bankers.

Speakers include Williams de Broe manager for Baltic markets Petri Karjalainen, Hansa Asset Management managing director Raul Malmstein, Trasta komercbanka president Girts Melbardis and Suprema sales and trading director Tomas Andrejauskas.
Registration for the conference can be made via the Latvian Business School on +371 721 1186, fax +371 722 4429 or email LBS@MAILBOX.RIGA.LV
